findings.source: GMK Center: Nucor has increased prices for hot-rolled coils by $15/t
findings.excerpt: According to Fastmarkets, the price of hot-rolled coil has risen by 52 per cent over the past year, reaching $1,255 per short tonne. This figure was last recorded in May 2022.

findings.claim: Nucor 2026 Q3 業績：淨利 $1.32B、EPS $5.80、平均售價 $1,493/short ton，Q4 預期與 Q3 持平或略高
findings.source: Nucor Reports Results for the Third Quarter of 2026 (SteelOrbis/Metal.com)
findings.excerpt: For the fourth quarter of 2026, Nucor expects earnings generally in line with or modestly higher than third-quarter levels, with Steel Mills segment earnings projected to remain stable as higher realized pricing is offset by seasonally lower volumes
